priceSnapshot.source: OKX Public API v5 (market/ticker), fetched via in-page fetch() from the okx.com origin using Claude in Chrome (WebFetch through the sandbox proxy returned 403 from the proxy for all OKX endpoints this run; browser in-page fetch used throughout for price, candles, open interest, funding, long/short ratio, and liquidation orders).
priceSnapshot.note: Morning closed at 83,414.1 (06:58 COT) with REDUCE firing (30% spot trim) after a long-liquidation flush to 82,874.5. Since then price never re-tested that low (session low 83,340.9 at 07:00 COT) and rallied intrabar to 84,944.4 (09:00 COT candle high), but that candle closed back down at 83,669.9 -- the breakout above the morning's addIf (84,628.2) was rejected intracandle, no settled close confirmed it. Now at 84,178.6, essentially mid-range, roughly flat (-0.07%) vs. the OKX 24h open.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close back below 82,874.5 (the flush low, unbroken this session) would signal the recovery attempt failed and downside continuation is resuming.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close above 84,628.2 (this session's pre-flush high, wicked through at 84,944.4 but never closed above) would confirm the flush was fully absorbed and support rebuilding the trimmed core.

decisionBox.changed: No new confirmation either way since the morning REDUCE: reduceIf (82,874.5) held as support (session low 83,340.9), and addIf (84,628.2) remains unbroken despite an intrabar wick to 84,944.4 on the 09:00 COT candle that closed back down at 83,669.9. Holding the post-REDUCE position; no further trim or add warranted yet -- the desk is waiting for a settled close outside the 82,875-84,628 box.

liquidation.note: ~364.1 BTC notional (~$30.9M) of short liquidations bucketed here over the last ~1h of OKX's realized-liquidation feed, just above the unbroken addIf/session-high zone (84,628-84,944) -- the largest fresh cluster this run.
~323.0 BTC notional (~$27.2M) of long liquidations bucketed here in the last ~5 minutes of the feed, essentially at the money.
~14.5 BTC notional of short liquidations, minor.
~0.4 BTC notional of long liquidations, negligible -- almost no fresh liquidity sits below current spot this run.

liquidityMagnet.source: OKX public liquidation-orders API (instType=SWAP, uly=BTC-USDT, state=filled, last 100 fills), fetched fresh via in-page fetch() on okx.com and aggregated into $250 buckets. Newest fill <1 minute old, oldest fill in the sample ~5 minutes old at fetch time -- well within the freshness guard.
liquidityMagnet.note: Nearly all fresh realized-liquidation volume this run sits above current spot (~705 BTC across 84,250-85,000) versus a negligible ~0.4 BTC below at 84,000. This reflects the session's whipsaw (longs flushed near 84,250 on an earlier dip, shorts flushed near 84,750 on the bounce to 84,944.4) rather than a clean one-directional magnet -- treat 84,750 as the nearer overhead friction zone, not a guaranteed target.

calibration.rollingRecord: Morning's REDUCE (trim 30% of the spot core at 83,414.1) landed right before the session's low print (83,340.9) and a subsequent bounce to 84,944.4 intrabar -- the trim caught close to the local bottom of this leg, so whether it helped is still unclear. No new reduce/add levels fired this session; price round-tripped the whole post-flush range (83,341-84,944) without a settled close outside the 82,875-84,628 box that has held since the flush.
calibration.note: reduceIf (82,874.5) and addIf (84,628.2) both carried over unchanged from the morning report; neither fired -- session low 83,340.9 never re-tested the flush low, and the rally to 84,944.4 (09:00 COT candle) was an intrabar wick that closed back down at 83,669.9, rejecting the breakout attempt intracandle.
